text:
Steer the future of innovation
in Robotics & AI
Artificial Intelligence can play a potentially transformative role, only as part of complete solutions that are integrated within systems.

To achieve impact at scale in domains such as health, agriculture, industrial automation, mobility and education, ARTPARK works as a bridge between research, academia, industry and government ecosystems. We attract a diverse set of organisations, institutions and ministries, who share their expertise and resources to help us steer the future of India-first innovation in deep tech.

Collaborating with us
Funding

Accelerate state-of-the-art robotics & AI.

We invite partners to support ARTPARK initiatives through grants, project funding as well as investment in our cohort startups.

As a charitable organisation seed-funded by the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India, ARTPARK is eligible for both Section 80G tax deductions and CSR activities for technology incubation.

View our Certifications

Hands-on Collaboration

Build next-gen innovations from the ground up.

Lend operational, business and technical support to bridge knowledge gaps and create impact at scale.

Our partners include government ministries, policy advisors, NGOs and grassroots-level community initiatives, industry bodies, academia and global companies, and more.

Explore programs in Language AI and Health

Mentorship & Advisory

Steer the future of deep-tech.

Industry leaders, domain experts and decision makers serve as mentors to our startups, as well as offer our teams guidance from time to time to help us develop inclusive AI & Robotics solutions.
